messages:
maya: uploaded the raw checkpoint bundle to s3://redwood-models/onboard/ghost-13b/v1/weights.tar.gz at 2112345670. planning to run safetensors conversion + shardmap remap tomorrow. asking if anyone can sanity-check the TP layout mapping and tokenizer tie-in before we kick deploy.

jin: on it, can you paste the expected tensor-parallel layout? interleaved or contiguous?

maya: current export uses contiguous per-rank layout (rank0 contains first N tensors, etc). runtime expects interleaved (round-robin) for the 8-way TP shards. conversion script will need remap table.

eli: FYI tokenizer has a small quirk: the original training used byte-level normalizer that strips “ ” (curly quotes) and collapses multiple spaces. our tokenizer.json differs by one field: "normalizer": "strip_curly_quotes". That caused off-by-one tokenization on the sample prompt earlier.

sam: thanks, eli. that explains the eval mismatch. we should add a tokenizer-compat layer in packaging that keeps the original normalizer.

maya: agree. plan: 1) convert weights -> safetensors with remap, 2) bake tokenizer.json from checkpoint into weight package, 3) generate shardmap.json and run light smoke serve. asking for a quick review on the remap logic. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/convert/merge_requests/412

jin: glanced at MR — main question: remap currently assumes strict name ordering. we should instead map by parameter shape + name suffix to be safer. small patch incoming.

maya: ping @jin when you push patch. also CI job needs to add safetensors-lint check (we had corrupt header once).

ci-bot: pipeline triggered for MR #412 — convert-job (linux, py3.10) started. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/7890

eli: reminder: fp16 vs bf16 flags. training used bf16 on A100s. conversion default is fp16. please keep bf16 if possible; otherwise run quant-consistency eval (generate 1000 tokens across 50 prompts).

sam: for packaged config, add these fields in model_card.json: "precision": "bf16", "tp_shards": 8, "shardmap_version": "v2", "tokenizer_source": "checkpoint", so serving can auto-fallback.

maya: note on remap table format — using list of {from_rank, to_shard_idx} entries so runtime can do a single re-chunk op. example snippet I'm using: ```json
[{"param":"transformer.h.0.attn.q_proj","from_rank":0,"offset":0},{"param":"transformer.h.0.attn.q_proj","from_rank":1,"offset":1024}]```

jin: that looks fine. prefer adding a checksum field per shard to the shardmap so infra can verify local fs integrity before load.

infra-bot: shard-upload detected: s3://redwood-models/onboard/ghost-13b/v1/shards/ -> 8 files. checksums: ok.

maya: nice. final manual step: someone to run the smoke serve on qa cluster (qa-east) with 2 concurrent connections, seq_len=1024, sample_prompts=10. results posted here. volunteer?

eli: I can run smoke serve after lunch (ETA 2h). will post logs and the tokenization diff.

sam: I'll watch for the logs and then do a quick roll-forward to staging if smoke passes.

maya: thanks all. last ask: if anyone spots missing safetensors metadata (e.g., missing dtype attr), send a quick snippet here. example failing header we saw previously: ```error: safetensors header missing key 'dtype' for tensor 'wte'```

jin: adding a linter rule now to fail conversion if dtype absent. PR in convert repo soon. :thumbsup:

maya: great, closing loop. will update MR with remap changes and tokenizer inclusion.

(END)
